description: Certain emotes have special sitting equivalents. Also sits your character in a chair if the chair is nearby. * Moving while seated will cause your character to stand. >> Subcommands: on - Switch to a sitting position. off - Switch to standing position. Toggle between sitting and standing when no subcommand is specified.
Perform your Grand Company's salute. * Cannot be performed by those of Recruit rank.
Offer solemn words of prayer to the Twelve or whatever gods it is you keep.
Make air quotes. * Motion not accompanied by a log message.
Fall to your knees in unworthiness.
